command:
set -eu
if [ -d /homeassistant ] && [ -w /homeassistant ]; then BASE=/homeassistant; elif [ -d /homeassistant_config ] && [ -w /homeassistant_config ]; then BASE=/homeassistant_config; else echo "No writable Home Assistant config mount" >&2; exit 1; fi
DATA="$BASE/hpvc-data"
JOURNAL="$DATA/runtime-history.json"
mkdir -p "$DATA"
if [ ! -f "$JOURNAL" ]; then
  LEGACY=""
  [ -f /homeassistant/hpvc-insight-history.json ] && LEGACY=/homeassistant/hpvc-insight-history.json
  [ -z "$LEGACY" ] && [ -f /homeassistant_config/hpvc-insight-history.json ] && LEGACY=/homeassistant_config/hpvc-insight-history.json
  if [ -n "$LEGACY" ]; then
    node - "$LEGACY" "$JOURNAL" <<'NODE'
const fs = require('fs');
const legacyPath = process.argv[2];
const journalPath = process.argv[3];
let legacy = null;
try { legacy = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(legacyPath, 'utf8')); } catch (_) {}
const valid = legacy && typeof legacy === 'object' && typeof legacy.date === 'string' && Array.isArray(legacy.entries);
const journal = valid ? {
  version: 1,
  date: legacy.date,
  savedAt: Date.now(),
  insightLog: { date: legacy.date, entries: legacy.entries },
  activity: [],
  activityMeta: null,
  reportInsightHistory: null,
  dailyAccuracy: null,
  migratedFromLegacyInsightHistory: true
} : {};
fs.writeFileSync(journalPath, JSON.stringify(journal));
NODE
  else
    printf '%s' '{}' > "$JOURNAL"
  fi
fi
ln -sfn "$DATA" /tmp/hpvc-data-root
printf 'ready\n'

name: Evaluate Battery Telemetry Health
func:
// Interpret the fresh per-battery telemetry health collected on HPVC Inputs.
const hpvc = msg.hpvc || {};
if (hpvc.halted) return msg;

const source = Array.isArray(hpvc.hbcBatteryTelemetryHealth)
    ? hpvc.hbcBatteryTelemetryHealth
    : [];
const hbcBatteryTelemetry = source.map(record => ({
    index: Number(record.index),
    powerEntity: record.powerEntity,
    socEntity: record.socEntity,
    power: record.power !== null && record.power !== undefined && Number.isFinite(Number(record.power)) ? Number(record.power) : null,
    soc: record.soc !== null && record.soc !== undefined && Number.isFinite(Number(record.soc)) ? Number(record.soc) : null,
    powerAgeMs: Number.isFinite(Number(record.powerAgeMs)) ? Number(record.powerAgeMs) : null,
    socAgeMs: Number.isFinite(Number(record.socAgeMs)) ? Number(record.socAgeMs) : null,
    powerUpdatedMs: Number.isFinite(Number(record.powerUpdatedMs)) ? Number(record.powerUpdatedMs) : null,
    socUpdatedMs: Number.isFinite(Number(record.socUpdatedMs)) ? Number(record.socUpdatedMs) : null,
    powerNumeric: record.powerNumeric === true,
    socNumeric: record.socNumeric === true,
    powerFresh: record.powerFresh === true,
    socFresh: record.socFresh === true,
    chargingCutoffEntity: record.chargingCutoffEntity || '',
    dischargingCutoffEntity: record.dischargingCutoffEntity || '',
    rs485Entity: record.rs485Entity || '',
    rs485State: String(record.rs485State || 'unknown'),
    rs485Available: record.rs485Available === true,
    rs485Enabled: record.rs485Enabled === true,
    telemetryUsable: record.telemetryUsable === true,
    cutoffConfigUsable: record.cutoffConfigUsable === true,
    cutoffSource: String(record.cutoffSource || 'unknown'),
    cutoffConfigIssue: String(record.cutoffConfigIssue || ''),
    chargingCutoff: record.chargingCutoff !== null && record.chargingCutoff !== undefined && Number.isFinite(Number(record.chargingCutoff)) ? Number(record.chargingCutoff) : null,
    dischargingCutoff: record.dischargingCutoff !== null && record.dischargingCutoff !== undefined && Number.isFinite(Number(record.dischargingCutoff)) ? Number(record.dischargingCutoff) : null,
    atChargingCutoff: record.atChargingCutoff === true,
    atDischargingCutoff: record.atDischargingCutoff === true,
    boundaryIdle: record.boundaryIdle === true,
    activePower: record.activePower === true,
    heartbeatAgeMs: Number.isFinite(Number(record.heartbeatAgeMs)) ? Number(record.heartbeatAgeMs) : null,
    heartbeatFresh: record.heartbeatFresh === true,
    freshnessMode: String(record.freshnessMode || 'unknown'),
    usable: record.usable === true,
    faults: Array.isArray(record.faults) ? record.faults.map(String) : []
}));

hpvc.hbcBatteryTelemetry = hbcBatteryTelemetry;
msg.hpvc = hpvc;
return msg;

command:
set -eu
if [ -d /homeassistant ] && [ -w /homeassistant ]; then BASE=/homeassistant; elif [ -d /homeassistant_config ] && [ -w /homeassistant_config ]; then BASE=/homeassistant_config; else echo "No writable Home Assistant config mount for HPVC reports" >&2; exit 1; fi
REPORT="$BASE/www/hpvc"
mkdir -p "$REPORT"
# Repair the narrow startup-race failure mode from older deployments: if a
# report write created the alias as a real directory before initialization,
# remove that HPVC-owned /tmp directory before creating the symlink.
if [ -e /tmp/hpvc-report-root ] && [ ! -L /tmp/hpvc-report-root ]; then rm -rf /tmp/hpvc-report-root; fi
ln -sfn "$REPORT" /tmp/hpvc-report-root
if [ ! -L /tmp/hpvc-report-root ]; then echo "HPVC report storage alias was not created as a symlink" >&2; exit 1; fi
rm -f "$REPORT/support-report.tmp.html" "$REPORT"/support-report.*.tmp.html
# Verify the selected report directory is actually writable before enabling generation.
PROBE="$REPORT/.hpvc-write-probe-$$"
: > "$PROBE"
rm -f "$PROBE"
printf 'ready\n'
name: Initialize report storage and remove stale temp files
info: Selects a writable Home Assistant config mount, repairs an accidental real /tmp/hpvc-report-root directory, creates/verifies the symlink, probes report-directory writability, removes stale temp files, and emits ready only after success.

name: Periodic report storage recovery check
info: Every 30 seconds, asks the bounded retry function to recover report storage only when it is not ready.

name: Retry report storage initialization if needed
info: Retries report-storage initialization after a transient startup/filesystem failure. User requests can trigger an immediate bounded retry; a 30-second periodic check provides automatic recovery without a tight loop.
